verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot documents Automations that run the Copilot cloud agent automatically, either on a schedule or in response to repository events such as an issue being opened. The cloud agent then works independently in the background, which covers recurring schedules and event triggers, not just one-off tasks. missing for 10: detailed docs on automation configuration and supported trigger types beyond issue-opened, independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled agents reliably maintain and fix code unattended.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously

citations.quote: Automations let you run Copilot cloud agent automatically, on a schedule or in response to events in a repository.
Set up an automation to run Copilot automatically, on a schedule or in response to events such as an issue being opened.
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
